cover_title: Dekh Ke Khush Mat Ho Jao
cover_sub: Online sale me fake discounts kaise spot karein? Ye 5 smart tips try karo.

slides.heading: Fake Inflated MRP Check Karo
slides.body: Sale se pehle products ka original MRP badha diya jata hai taaki bada discount dikhe. Hamesha product ka real price yaad rakho.
slides.tip: Maan lo normal price high hai, toh discount real nahi hai.

slides.heading: Price History Tracker Use Karo
slides.body: Price tracker tools se check karo ki product last 30 days me kitne ka tha. Tab pata chalega ki deal sachi hai ya nahi.
slides.tip: Lowest price graph check karke hi buy button dabao.

slides.heading: Other Websites Pe Compare Karo
slides.body: Sirf ek app pe mat ruko. Same product doosri shopping sites par search karo. Kai baar bina sale ke bhi sasta mil jata hai.
slides.tip: Search engine par model number daal kar price compare karo.

slides.heading: Seller Rating Aur Reviews Dekho
slides.body: Bada discount dene wala seller authentic hai ya nahi, ye rating se pata chalta hai. Low rating vale seller se bach kar raho.
slides.tip: Good rating aur recent reviews check karna mat bhoolo.

slides.heading: Final Cart Price Checkout Karo
slides.body: Banner price par mat jao. Bank offers, platform fees aur shipping apply hone ke baad final checkout page ka price check karo.
slides.tip: Hamesha payment page par final price check karke order karo.
